notes.title: WarRock2 Patch Notes – New Weapons, Scopes & Fixes
notes.content:
WarRock2 Patch Notes – New Weapons, Scopes & Fixes
 February 5, 2025
This update introduces new weapons, optics, and gameplay improvements. AI spawn and trigger mechanics have also been updated.

■ New Weapons
New firearms have been added and can be looted from AI bots and item containers.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/801021959205814282/1337012019341164584/Patch_Notes_New_Weapons_Scopes.jpg?ex=67a5e4f9&is=67a49379&hm=b30a583196db489386d9dd13a9ff80f7a40609f7a6e23050e68487743fb3f2e1&=&format=webp

■ New Scopes & Optics
New optics have been added for improved combat versatility.
◆ Tactical & Close-Range Optics
Elcan Specter
EOTech Holographic Sight
EOTech HHS II
Red Dot Sight
Kobra Reflex Sight
Trijicon ACOG
Holographic Sight
🔹 Long-Range Scopes
Leupold Mark 8 CQBSS
Primary Arms PLx 6 Athena

■ Weapon Availability
All new weapons and optics can be looted from AI bots or found in item containers.

■ Additional Updates & Fixes
◆ General Updates
Scope icon replacements
AI spawn and trigger adjustments
◆ Bug Fixes
Fixed M2010 ESR third-person animation bug.
Fixed syringe animation playing as a firearm.
Fixed ADS stamina-related issue.
